audio.note: These devices apply to the Voice tab: recording from the microphone and playing recordings. The system default device follows your Windows settings. With virtual devices (e.g. SteelSeries Sonar, Steam Streaming) pick the one where you actually hear sound.
browser.noSelection: Select a model to see its description.
browser.search.tip: Search by model name or description
browser.title: Browse models
chat.deleteSession.tip: Deletes the selected session from disk
chat.empty: Type a message below to start the conversation. You can add images with the button, paste them (Ctrl+V) or drag them onto the panel.
chat.incognito.tip: A new conversation without saving: nothing from it reaches the disk
chat.level.tip: low, medium or high; sent only to models that support a level
chat.msg.noImages: This model does not accept images: the message may be rejected. Choose a model with image support.
chat.msg.toolLoop: Aborted: the model asked for tools too many times in a row.
chat.msg.toolRejected: The user rejected the tool call.
chat.newSession.tip: Starts a new conversation; the previous one is saved
chat.pasteImage.tip: Pastes an image from the clipboard (Ctrl+V in the message box does it too)
chat.reasoning.tip: The model will show its reasoning (if it returns it). Some models cannot be turned off completely
chat.sessions.note: Sessions are saved after every reply; an incognito session is not saved and disappears when closed. Ctrl+Enter sends the message.
chat.system.tip: Sent at the start of every conversation, e.g. a role or response style
chat.tokens.tip: Input tokens (the whole conversation history), output tokens and those served from the provider's cache
common.editPrompt.tip: Prompt editor in a separate window: configuration, concept, AI rewrite
common.name: Name
common.savePreset.tip: Save the prompt, model and parameters as a preset
dialog.toolCall.title: Tool call
edit.paste.tip: Pastes an image from the clipboard (e.g. a screenshot)
edit.refs.note: The first image is the primary one.
edit.sizeNote: The edit endpoint does not accept a size: the result is fitted to the aspect ratio locally.
edit.url.tip: http(s) address of a JPG, PNG or WEBP image
filter.title: Model filters
gallery.confirmDelete:
Remove from the gallery and delete from disk?

{0}
gallery.confirmDelete.title: Deleting from disk
gallery.msg.cleared: Gallery cleared (image files stay in the output folder).
gallery.msg.deleted: Removed from the gallery and deleted from disk.
gallery.msg.removed: Removed from the gallery (the file stays in the output folder).
gen.err.noImages: Model {0} does not accept images. Choose a model with the image icon.
gen.negative.tip: What you do not want in the image (works when the model supports it)
gen.quality.tip: auto = the quality parameter is not sent
gen.seed.tip: Empty = random. A number = reproducible result
mcpServer.copied: Client configuration copied (it contains a token, do not share it).
model.cost.none: No price in the catalog (the provider publishes prices for some models only).
model.icon.reasoning: Reasoning (can be turned on and its level set)
models.msg.loading: Loading the model list and prices...
msg.noClipboardImage: The clipboard does not contain an image.
out.clear.tip: Clears the result view (the gallery stays)
out.copy.tip: Copy the image to the clipboard
out.fit.tip: Fit the image to the window
out.restart.tip: Plays the video again from the start
out.saveAs.tip: Save the result to a chosen location (Ctrl+S)
param.seed.tip: A fixed seed gives reproducible results
param.temperature.tip: Randomness of replies: lower = more predictable
param.topk.tip: Number of most probable tokens to choose from
param.topp.tip: Nucleus sampling: limits to the most probable tokens
picker.reload.tip: Reloads the model lists and prices from the provider
presetSave.err.noName: The model did not return a name.
presetSave.msg.thinking: The AI is coming up with a name...
presetSave.note: The preset saves the prompt, model, size, parameters and enhancement settings. The file name is created automatically.
presetSave.suggest.tip: The text model suggests a name and description based on the prompt
presets.confirmDelete.title: Deleting a preset
presets.import.tip: Converts prompts.json from the previous version into presets
presets.msg.emptyName: The preset name cannot be empty.
presets.title: Settings presets
prompt.concept.tip: Description of what the image or video should show; no technical parameters
prompt.config: GENERATION CONFIGURATION: how to make it (style, technique, light, format)
prompt.config.tip: Technical parameters for the generator. Do not describe the scene here.
prompt.confirmOverwrite:
Overwrite the prompt in the preset “{0}”?

The current content of the preset will be lost (model, size and parameters stay).
prompt.confirmReplace: Replace the current prompt in the window with the prompt from the preset “{0}”?
prompt.context.tip: Previous rewrites are sent to the model as context (the last 6) so it does not lose earlier decisions
prompt.describe.tip: The chosen text model will describe the tab's images (or chosen files if there are none) and append the description to the concept
prompt.header: EXPECTED RESULT: what the generator should show (subject and scene)
prompt.hint: Ctrl+Enter confirms, Esc cancels. Ctrl+Z undoes changes in the field.
prompt.load.tip: Inserts the prompt from the selected preset into the window
prompt.overwrite.tip: Saves the prompt from the window into the selected preset (after confirmation); the rest of the preset is unchanged
prompt.rewrite.tip: The enhancing model will rewrite the concept (and separate the configuration) following the instructions above
prompt.technical: Technical prompt for the model (concept rewrite instructions)
prompt.technical.tip: Instruction for the enhancing model, e.g. “add lighting, keep the language and meaning”
provider.chatgpt.done: Signed in. You can close this tab and return to ImageStudio.
provider.chatgpt.note: Sign in with your ChatGPT account (Plus or Pro): requests use your plan, no API key needed. Only chat is available (including images as input); image, video and audio generation are not supported. Models depend on the account and limits come from the plan. OpenAI must allow the app to use plan usage.
provider.chatgpt.waiting: Waiting for the sign-in to finish in the browser…
provider.defaultText.note: Used for prompt enhancement, chat and preset names. The Refresh button loads the provider's model list using the address and key entered above (without saving).
provider.envOverride: The environment variable {0} is set and takes precedence over the key entered here.
provider.keysNote: Keys are encrypted (DPAPI) for the current Windows account. They are never written to project files or the repository.
provider.kilo.note: Text models from the Kilo catalog (including free ones) with prices per 1M tokens. Kilo Auto Free needs no credits. No image or video generation.
provider.mistral.note: Text models (including vision) and speech recognition (Voxtral). The Mistral API does not publish prices, so the list has none. No image or video generation.
provider.openai.base.tip: E.g. https://api.openai.com or the address of a proxy / OpenAI-compatible server
provider.openai.noVideo: This provider does not support video.
provider.opencodego.note: Models from the OpenCode Go subscription, prices per 1M tokens from the catalog. Key from the opencode.ai console. No image or video generation.
provider.or.note: Text, image and video models are available. Image prices are token prices (per 1M), video: per second when the catalog provides it.
provider.preferredOnly.tip: You choose preferred models in the "Browse models" window next to the filters. An empty preferred list shows all models.
provider.title: AI provider
ref.msg.addedClipboard: Image added from the clipboard. References: {0}
ref.msg.downloading: Downloading the image from the link...
ref.msg.tooLarge: The image is larger than 25 MB.
settings.maxSide: Maximum long side of the source image (px)
settings.streaming.tip: The reply text (and reasoning) appears in the chat as the model generates it. Off: the reply appears only when it is complete
settings.title: Settings
size.title: Output aspect ratio
tools.confirm: Ask for consent before every call
tools.confirm.tip: Recommended: tools can read files, send data and change things outside the app
tools.control: The model can control the app (models, prompts, generation)
tools.control.tip: imagestudio__* tools: model choice, prompts, size, gallery and generation (costs money, but asks for consent)
tools.copyConfig.tip: Paste it into the MCP client configuration; it contains the access token
tools.json.note: Format as in Claude Desktop: {"mcpServers": {"name": {"command": "npx", "args": [...]}}} or {"url": "https://...", "headers": {...}}. Tokens in the file are plain text.
tools.server.enable: Expose app control to MCP clients (this computer only)
tools.server.note: Access only from this computer and with a token. Every external generation requires confirmation in the app.
video.msg.noImages: The selected model does not accept images. Choose an image → video or reference → video model.
video.paidNote: Video generation is paid. Every click creates a new job.
video.paste.tip: Pastes an image from the clipboard as a video attachment
voice.clearGallery.tip: Removes gallery entries; audio files stay on disk
voice.delete.confirm: Remove from the gallery and from disk?{0}{0}{1}
voice.delete.title: Deleting from disk
voice.empty: Recordings and texts will appear here. Type text to read aloud, or record your voice and recognize it.
voice.err.micStart: Could not start the microphone: {0}. Check Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
voice.err.mics: Could not read the list of microphones: {0}
voice.err.noMic: No microphone found. Check the connection and Windows Settings → Privacy → Microphone.
voice.err.noTextModel: No text model for translation. Choose one in the Chat tab or in Settings.
voice.err.play: Could not play the recording: {0}. Use "Open in player".
voice.err.speakers: Could not read the list of audio outputs: {0}
voice.err.tooBig: The file is larger than 40 MB (the API limit). Choose a shorter recording.
voice.gallery.label: Voice gallery: {0} · total ~${1:0.0000}
voice.language.note: Choosing a language translates the text with a text model (a separate, cheap token cost) and reads the translation. The voice should support that language, otherwise it speaks with a foreign accent.
voice.language.tip: Speech models read the text in its own language. With a language chosen, the text is first translated by a text model
voice.openExternal.tip: Opens the file in the system's default player
voice.output.tip: The device the recordings play on
voice.save.title: Save recording
voice.status.cleared: Voice gallery cleared (the files stay on disk).
voice.status.deleted: Removed from the gallery and from disk.
voice.toSynth.tip: Inserts this text into the text-to-speech field
